spans.s:
m. (-चिः)
The female breast or bosom.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A nipple.
E.
चुष to such, and क affix, deriv. irr. or चुचु imitative sound, (such as a child makes in sucking,) and क what sounds; also चुचूक and चूचुक.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A nipple.
E.
चूष to suck, and deriv. irr.; or चूचु imitative sound, (in sucking,) and क what makes; also चुचुक, &c.

(ई) चुच्यी r. 1st cl. (चोच्यति)
1 To distil, to drop.
2 To bathe.
